Thank you! To answer your question, I had the narrative framework developed beforehand. I knew where I wanted to start, and I knew where I wanted to end, and I knew that I wanted the story set in the same thematic universe as some of my previous science fiction short stories. As far as most of the characters and flavor text and dialog that pushes the narrative along, I came up with most of that while I was learning the programming and creating the assets. I think it's good to have the basic structure in your head when you start, but creating as you go along helps to keep a consistent tone and keeps you from becoming bored with your own project. Once I know how every little thing is going to happen in a story or a game, it becomes much more tedious to work on, at least for me.
